reviews.author: Rose Bloom
reviews.text:
RAYG Handyman Service
Ray recently tiled my kitchen and also plumbed in a new shower and toilet, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, his work was absolutely first class.
The tiling in the kitchen is flawless – precise, clean, and finished to a really high standard. The plumbing work was equally impressive; everything was installed perfectly, works exactly as it should, and was done with great attention to detail. You can tell Ray takes real pride in his work.
He was punctual, reliable, and professional throughout, kept everything tidy, and clearly explained what he was doing at each stage. On top of that, he’s friendly, easy to deal with, and completely trustworthy – which makes a huge difference when having work done in your home.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Ray to anyone looking for high-quality tiling or plumbing work. Brilliant service and fantastic results.
Thank you
Daphne
